raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly fixed the earliest “release” of Icehouse pieces as 1999 (Looney Labs’ Martian Chess set), conflating a later re-release with the original availability of the pieces. This ignored earlier commercial manufacturing/distribution starting around 1989 by Icehouse Games and skipped verifying with sources (e.g., BGG/publisher pages) despite instructing to do so. That wrong baseline would lead to the incorrect conclusion that Kill Doctor Lucky (1996) came first.
